children: SandRidge Energy’s third-quarter revenue and earnings rose year over year, as higher oil and NGL prices and increased sales volumes lifted revenue. Higher derivative losses and production taxes partly offset the gains, while a $14.2 million deferred tax benefit from a valuation-allowance release supported net income.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Total volumes were 1,922 MBoe, up from 1,745 MBoe; average daily volumes rose to 20.9 MBoe/d from 19.0 MBoe/d.
: Average reported oil prices rose to $85.27 per Bbl from $65.23, and NGL prices to $22.68 per Bbl from $15.61; natural gas prices eased to $1.62 per Mcf from $1.71.
: Lease operating expenses were comparable year over year and fell to $5.75 per Boe from $6.25; production taxes increased primarily with higher oil and NGL prices and sales volumes.
: In August, the company closed its acquisition of Cherokee Play producing assets and leasehold interests for $47.9 million in cash consideration, before customary adjustments.
: The company plans one-rig Cherokee development, production optimization through artificial-lift conversions, and leasing to bolster future development.
